title: omaflake image
description: image.json in an image package (<name>.omaflake-image): what the image is. v2: look, lookChoice, credential, credentialName. v3 (plan B141): locale, localeName.

recipeSource.description: The recipe source it was built from

system.description: Architecture as Nix names a system

source.description: The image flake it was built with (folder or URL)

revision.description: The recipe's state when it was built

storePath.description: NixOS: the image's store path; macOS: the nix-darwin system

look.description: The guest look it was built with (v2; e.g. omaflake, catppuccin, rose-pine-dawn, vanilla) – left out for an image built before looks

lookChoice.description: The look chosen for the build; left out: the recipe's own

credential.description: The credential it was built with (its id); left out: this computer's values

credentialName.description: That credential's name when it was built

locale.description: The locale it was built with (its ID)

localeName.description: That locale's name when it was built
